Name: Itadori Yuji NPC - Jujutsu Kaisen
Author: yujihat
Description:
[b][size=4][u]Brief Overview[/u]

[/size][/b][size=2]Yuji just landed in Pelican Town. He deserves the peaceful life, he's been traumatized enough.

For those of us who have been keeping up with the manga, I've kept certain characters alive because I am unable to cope otherwise <3

For those who have NOT been keeping up with the manga, DO NOT READ THE MANGA SAVE YOURSELF and there's also not any major spoilers, don't worry :)

If you want to change his portrait to not have any scars, you can go to assets/img/extra portraits and switch them out :) I'll likely be updating his sprites as well, he's pretty much just a reskin of my Sukuna mod hehe.

[b]He is compatible with the Gojo mod by cursedcure!! Also compatible with my other mods.[/b]

[/size][u][size=4][b]Gift Likes/Dislikes[/b][/size][/u][size=2]

[b]Loves[/b]: Joja Cola, Sashimi, Maki Roll, Fried Eel, Pizza and all Universal Loves

[b]Likes[/b]: Pink Cake, Strange Bun, Fruit Salad and all Universal Likes

[b]Neutral[/b]: Carp and all Universal Neutrals

[b]Dislikes[/b]: Wine, Beer, Pale Ale, Mead, Urchin, Hops, and all Universal Dislikes

[b]Hates[/b]: Ruby, Escargot and all Universal Hates

[/size][size=4][b][u]Schedule
[/u][/b][/size][size=2]
Monday, Wednesday, Friday

0610 Starts at Alex's House
0800 Goes into town to sit by the river sort of near Sam's house
1600 Makes his way across town and hangs out at the bench near Joja Mart
2200 Heads back to Alex's House

Sunday, Tuesday

0610 Starts at Alex's House
0800 Heads up to the mountain lake
1600 Goes up to Linus' camp to hang out with him
2200 Returns to Alex's House

Thursday, Saturday

0610 Starts at Alex's House
0800 Heads to the Library
1600 Heads to Joja Mart
2200 Returns to Alex's House

[/size][size=4][b]Heart Events

[/b][/size][size=2][size=2]Yay he finally has heart events! Here is how to trigger them <3

[b][u]Two Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On Monday, Wednesday or Friday between 0800 and 1600 head into Town.

[b][u]Four Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On Tuesday or Sunday between 1600 and 2200 head to the Mountains.

[b][u]Six Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On a Thursday or Saturday between 0800 and 1600 head to the Museum.

[b][u]Eight Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On a Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday or Friday between 2200 and 0100 head into Town.

[b][u]Ten Heart Event [/u]

[/b]On any day, leave your house between the hours of 0600 and 1900, he will be there waiting for you :)

[b][u]Future Additions

[/u][/b]I do plan on adding the following;

[*][size=2]Movie Theater interactions and preferences [/size]
[*][size=2]Ginger Island [/size]
[*][size=2]Child pack to make his kids look more like him.[/size]
[*][size=2]Possibly a 14 heart event :)
[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size]
